name: Innai Kansen  2 ~Nariyamanu Nurse Call~
original_name: 淫内感染2 ～鳴り止まぬナースコール～
source:
A xonix puzzle game is interwoven with omnibus drama about characters of Innai Kansen series. There are 20 scenes that open up with stage clearance.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一款将Xonix类益智玩法与《淫内感染》系列角色单元剧交织在一起的游戏。通过关卡后可解锁场景，共有20个场景。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
